investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Ardworks Bank (digital banking); Platform: Microsoft Azure westeurope (zones westeurope-1/westeurope-2/westeurope-3); network range 10.183.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster ardwor-prod-westeu (AKS); Edge: two nginx load balancers (lb-01, lb-02) behind DNS round-robin terminate client connections for mobile-bff; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
